title: When feedback stops being feedback and becomes a performance conversation

videos.script: Marcos was stuck for two weeks on an upgrade, and said nothing. Renata gave him feedback. {{title}} Since then, two pieces of work estimated at three days took more than two weeks each. And a page on call waited forty minutes. {{since}} Each moment on its own is feedback. Together, after feedback was already given, they are something else. {{pattern}} This lesson is about that line. Three questions that say when you have crossed it. {{tests}} How to say it plainly, so the person leaves knowing there is a concern, what it is, and what happens next. {{plain}} And the summary you write that afternoon. Facts, what the person said, and an invitation to correct it. {{summary}}
